title: CouponsLookupResult
description: coupons.lookup-result@1: answers of coupons.coupon.lookup on OpenVibe.Coupons (public, anonymous allowed, cacheable: the same bytes for every caller). GET /api/v1/merchants/:id/coupons → { merchant, coupons } (the active codes); GET /api/v1/merchants/:id → { merchant }; GET /api/v1/coupons/:id → { coupon, merchant }. Inactive merchants and unpublished or disabled codes are 404.
